entity.name: UiBadge
entity.description: A small badge for labeling or categorizing content, optionally dismissible. Its API is generated from the component's Custom Elements Manifest; its guidance and accessibility notes are authored by hand.

docOrigin.note: API block generated from ui-badge.custom-elements.json (CEM schemaVersion 2.1.0) by cem-to-dsds. Use-cases, guidelines, and accessibility authored by hand.

metadata.summary: A small, optionally dismissible status/label badge.

items.description: Importing the module registers the `<ui-badge>` custom element.

properties.description: When true, the badge renders a close control and can be dismissed.

events.description: Fired after the badge is dismissed, whether by the close control or the dismiss() method.

slots.acceptedContent: Plain text or a text node. Do not nest interactive elements.

cssCustomProperties.description: Label text color of the badge.

cssParts.description: The dismiss control, present when dismissible is true.

methods.description: Dismisses the badge programmatically and fires the dismiss event.

items.description: When you need to label or categorize an item inline, such as a status tag on a list row.
When you need a dismissible marker the user can clear, such as an applied filter chip.
When the element should trigger an action on click.

alternative.rationale: A badge carries no interactive semantics. An action needs a control that announces itself as one and is keyboard-operable.

items.guidance: Do not use a badge as an interactive control. Use a button or a link.
items.rationale: A badge has no role, focus behavior, or keyboard handling of its own. An action placed on it is invisible to assistive technology and unreachable by keyboard.

items.guidance: Keep badge labels to one or two words.
items.rationale: Badges sit inline in dense contexts. Long labels wrap and break the surrounding layout.
